notes: 1. Students without pre- and co-requisites or written permission of the instructor can be de-registered from courses at any time. 2. See the departmental website at www.utm.utoronto.ca/dvs for the distribution of courses by area. 3. No St. George courses may be substituted for the required 100-level and 200-level courses. However, 0.5 credit at the 200-level in FAH may be taken at St. George in an area not covered by U of T Mississauga's offerings (i.e. one of the following courses: FAH248H1 , FAH260H1 , FAH262H1 , FAH270H1 , FAH272H1 ).
